glosses: passageway (any way for passing in, out or through something)
ticket (pass entitling the holder to board a train, a bus, a plane, or other means of transportation)

examples.text: Você sabia que havia uma passagem secreta?
examples.en: Did you know there was a secret passage?

examples.text: As passagens de trem são caras?
Quanto custa uma passagem de ônibus?
examples.en: How much does a bus ticket cost?
